en.probe.missing: Claude Code is not installed on this worker yet. It is installed automatically.
en.probe.installing: Installing Claude Code on this worker.
en.probe.install_failed: Installing Claude Code on this worker did not finish: {reason}. It is tried again in {minutes} min.
en.probe.signed_out: Claude Code is not signed in on this worker. Open a terminal on the worker and run `{command}`, or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the worker's environment.
en.probe.expired: The Claude Code sign-in on this worker has expired. Open a terminal on the worker and run `{command}`.
en.probe.keychain_locked: The macOS keychain on this worker is locked, so Claude Code cannot read its sign-in. A Mac keeps it locked after it restarts until someone logs in to it. Log in to the Mac once, or open a terminal on the worker and run `security unlock-keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db`, or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the worker's environment.
en.probe.could_not_run: Checking Claude Code on this worker did not finish: {reason}.
en.install.failed: Installing Claude Code did not finish: {reason}.
en.install.not_found_after: npm finished, but the Claude Code adapter is not where it was installed
en.install.unreachable: this worker can't reach {host} ({code}), so npm cannot download Claude Code. Check the worker's network connection, and its proxy if it needs one: npm reads HTTPS_PROXY and its own `proxy` setting
en.install.untrusted_certificate: this worker reaches {host} only through a certificate npm does not trust ({code}), as a firewall that inspects traffic presents. Give npm that certificate with `npm config set cafile <file>` on the worker
en.log.adapter_path: Claude Code runs claude-agent-acp {version} from the PATH, at {path}.
en.log.adapter_private: Claude Code runs claude-agent-acp {version}, installed by Frontier.
en.log.adapter_passed_over_older: The claude-agent-acp on the PATH at {path} is {version}, older than {minimum}, so it is not used.
en.log.adapter_passed_over_newer_major: The claude-agent-acp on the PATH at {path} is {version}, a major version after {minimum} that Frontier has not been tested with, so it is not used.
en.log.adapter_passed_over_unknown: The claude-agent-acp on the PATH at {path} does not say its version, so it is not used.
en.launch.missing: Claude Code is not installed on this worker yet. It is installed automatically, then the session starts.
en.launch.agent_description: The agent definition this session was started with.
en.status.about: Claude Code needs a Claude subscription, such as Pro or Max, or an Anthropic API key. You sign in once on each worker, in Claude Code itself. Frontier installs Claude Code on every worker and never holds your sign-in.
en.status.not_reported_reason: This worker has not reported on Claude Code yet.
en.status.no_workers: Claude Code runs on workers. Pair a worker from the Workers view, and it shows here.
en.status.signin_step_terminal: Open a terminal on the worker from the Workers view.
en.status.signin_step_run: Run the command its row above shows, usually
en.status.signin_step_done: Follow the link it prints. The worker shows as ready here within a minute.
en.status.signin_alternative: To use an API key instead, set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the environment the worker runs in, then restart the worker.
